item.text: The failure occurs while comparing an archive member with an existing destination file. `zipinfo` reports `19800000.000000`, and the current `strptime` call raises because ZIP timestamps can contain zero month and day fields. I’ll add a regression case that reaches that comparison path.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat >> .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'

Root cause: "'`ZipArchive.is_unarchived` parses the `zipinfo -T` timestamp with `time.strptime` and constructs `datetime.datetime`. A ZIP entry with zero month/day yields `19800000.000000`; `strptime` raises before extraction can be considered. The path is reached when the destination member exists. Working pattern elsewhere in this module is to validate parsed archive metadata before comparing it. Hypothesis: validating the fixed-width date fields and falling back to the 1980 ZIP epoch will allow normal comparison and extraction for malformed entries.
EOF'

item.text:
Fixed the unarchive crash for ZIP entries with invalid timestamps. `ZipArchive._valid_time_stamp` now validates the date and uses the 1980 ZIP epoch when it is invalid, so `is_unarchived` can continue processing the entry.

The regression test reproduced the reported `ValueError` before the fix. After the fix, all 13 unarchive unit tests pass, and `git diff --check` passes.
